messages:
sam: Heads up — just got a report from Acme: a streaming request fell back and they saw both provisional + confirmed charges show up. customer billing ticket incoming.
jia: ugh. which route did it fall back to? provisional should be de-duped on finalization.
sam: it fell back from fast-route -> soft-route when KV cache evicted. console trace shows provisional credited on the initial path then confirmed credited again after handoff.
omar: runtime trace: we do a handoff with a new resume token when prefetch snapshot is evicted. session_id changes for the toolcall path.
michelle: console currently displays both provisional and confirmed entries. we show provenance but no automatic correlation between them.
jia: sounds like ledger entries lack a common tag to link provisional->final across route swaps. we only dedupe by client session id which changes on handoff.
omar: exact. logs snippet:
```
LEDGER|session=abc123 fallback=true provisional=true tokens=23
LEDGER|session=def456 fallback=false provisional=false tokens=23
```
those look distinct to the reconciler.
michelle: user-facing question: do we hide provisional when a fallback occurs? customers complain when they see provisional then confirmed (looks like double-charge even if we later credit).
sam: proposal: hide provisional for fallbacks by default in the console, add a toggle to show them. simultaneously fix ledger so provisional gets a fallback_tag that matches final entry.
natalie: telemetry note: we currently emit `route` and `provisional` flags but not `soft_fallback` on ledger metrics. need to add that to make dashboards reliable.
jia: billing approval: we can auto-credit duplicates but need a strong matching heuristic. fallback_tag would help but we also need prefix hash logic for streaming prefix matches.
omar: corner case: truncation + toolcall split. if the client truncates mid-toolcall we may generate a truncated_toolcall on the fallback path with different token accounting. matching by prefix-hash must tolerate suffix truncation.
sam: concrete plan:
  1) UX quick fix: hide provisional entries by default on any route that used soft fallback, add FAQ blurb explaining why.
  2) Runtime change: attach `fallback_tag` (derived from initial prefix-hash + original_session) to provisional ledger entries during handoff.
  3) Billing reconciler: nightly job to detect provisional+confirmed duplicates and auto-credit customers with audit log.
  4) Telemetry: add `provisional_rate_by_route` metric and an alert when >1% sustained for 5m.

michelle: can do the console toggle and tooltip this sprint, will file frontend issue.
natalie: I'll add the metric & alert and fork the provisional dashboard for the SLO runbook.
omar: I'll open PR to attach `fallback_tag` and include a mapping table in the runtime trace; will add tests for truncation + handoff.
jia: i'll draft the reconciler spec and cost/impact estimate. need legal/billing approval for automatic credits.
sam: thanks. short term: michelle, can you hide provisional on fallback within 48h? that will reduce customer confusion.
michelle: yes, aiming for a small flag + feature flag rollout behind `console.hide_provisional_on_fallback`.
deploy-bot: deployment queued for PR #4123 (console toggle) — env: staging :rocket:
jia: one more ask — add an example in the billing FAQ showing the ledger lines and how we reconcile, so support can triage.
michelle: will add a short FAQ snippet and link to the reconciler RFC when ready.
sam: awesome. let's sync tomorrow 10am for status. // @natalie pls confirm alert + dashboard before EOD
natalie: on it. will post dashboard link in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
